title: Operator Results
description: Recorded operator (or upstream agent) results consumed by the acceptance runner via --operator-results <path>. Today consumed by the `manual` and `agent` backends. The runner's on-disk assertion handlers always re-score the live workspace; operator-recorded assertions are merged in for audit purposes only and never substitute for verification.

scenario.description: Optional scenario id check. The runner logs a warning when the file's scenario disagrees with the running scenario rather than aborting, so a single results file can be re-used across closely-related suites.

completed.description: Operator's coarse pass/fail signal. Surfaced in summary.md but does not gate the runner-owned assertion stage.

notes.description: Free-form notes from the operator. Surfaced in summary.md.

verifierStdout.description: Optional stdout the operator captured from a verifier script. Forwarded to the runner-owned `verifier-clean` assertion handler when present.

slices.description: Per-slice define-stage artifact bodies. Keys are plan-entry names (the slice names emitted by /change:plan). A slice missing from this map falls back to the deterministic stub bodies, so partial recordings still yield a runnable scenario.

proposal.description: Body written to .specify/specs/<slice>/proposal.md by the agent phase driver.

spec.description: Body written to .specify/specs/<slice>/spec.md by the agent phase driver. The slice-has-spec assertion accepts either spec.md or specs/main.md on disk.

tasks.description: Body written to .specify/specs/<slice>/tasks.md by the agent phase driver.

design.description: Body written to .specify/specs/<slice>/design.md by the agent phase driver, OR null/omitted for capability briefs that do not produce design.md (today: `contracts`). The capability policy table in acceptance/assertions/define.ts is the single source of truth for which slices require design.md.

residue.description: Optional residue file body written into the workspace clone before the residue commit. When omitted the agent backend uses the deterministic stub's residue path/body so the C10/C11 commit-shape rules continue to hold.

assertions.description: Optional per-id verdicts the operator already collected. Merged into assertions.json for audit purposes only — runner-owned dispatcher records win when ids collide.

id.description: Assertion id matching one of the ids in scenario.frontmatter.assertions.

verdict.description: The operator's recorded verdict for this assertion.

evidence.description: Free-form evidence pointer surfaced in summary.md.

fault-domain.description: Optional fault-domain hint. See acceptance/assertions/README.md for the canonical list.
